items.headline: Steel and Sears Dams on Rock River won't be removed
items.summary: The Illinois DNR studied safety modifications after a 5-year-old girl drowned in 2018. But it recommended to remove both dams.

items.headline: Facade of Muscatine Masonic Temple partially collapses
items.summary: Fire officials aren't concerned about public safety, but the alley surrounding the facade is blocked off as a precautionary measure.
